capsule.scenery: Not a room: no slots and no tag; it changes no location, occupancy, capacity, eligibility, movement or immunity (G-02). Its only targets are each seated participant's own seat (capsuleTargets()), as its slot is.
capsule.targets: capsuleTargets(panel): a 44 px square per seated participant, on its chest, inside the panel, below the caption (CAPTION_CLEAR) and apart; live only while that participant is drawn seated
capsule.layout: fit.mjs fitBoardV2(viewport, roster, { capsule: true }): beside the Command Room, on its right, in the top band; the band's inside width less the gap and the four borders shared 2:1.
capsule.paths: Each seat's path in: the points its feet pass, from the doorway to its stop beside its chair (scene units); the way out is the same path backward. Neither crosses the table.
